title: LMDB put/get/delete each opens a new transaction
description: O(1) but WRITE SERIALISATION — LmdbBlockDb.put/get/delete (lmdb/src/lib.rs:140-166) each open and commit their own transaction. LMDB allows one write transaction at a time (env-level mutex). Transit calls put_raw once per article; if a burst of articles arrives, each one acquires the write mutex sequentially plus fsync overhead. Fix: expose a batch-write path (single write txn for N blocks) so the pipeline can write multiple blocks in one commit, amortising the per-commit cost.
